I think you're reading the stack trace upside down. The code does not make many recursive calls from `RandomAccessFile` into `CacheDataSource.erad`. What's happening is many recursive calls to `CacheDataSource.read where the recursion is eventually terminating and calling into `RandomAccessFile`. The fact that it does eventually terminate suggests that no stack overflow is occuring.

Please could you clarify. Where is this stack trace coming from, and how are you concluding that it's actually a stack overflow as opposed to just being quite deep?

Sorry!  I am checking my code. Pls close this this issue.

Although I still don't understand the stack trace, there is something strange going on here (we don't expect more than one recursive call). I think it's probably caused by a cache file becoming truncated underneath the application. We'll push a change to make `SimpleCache` more robust against this occurrence.

issue.title: Crash when using CacheDataSource

repository.name: ExoPlayer
repository.description: This project is deprecated and stale. The latest ExoPlayer code is available in https://github.com/androidx/media

issue.body:
### [REQUIRED] Issue description
Thanks for developing such a great app, I learned a lot from it.
But now I suffered a crash with it after using the `CacheDataSource` and related class

This is the code I use for adding cache for player:
```
fun buildCacheDataSourceFactory(context: Context, bandwidthMeter: DefaultBandwidthMeter?): DataSource.Factory {
            val httpDataSourceFactory =
                    DefaultHttpDataSourceFactory(Util.getUserAgent(context, APPLICATION_NAME), bandwidthMeter)
            val cache = getCacheSingleInstance(context)
            return CacheDataSourceFactory(cache, httpDataSourceFactory, CacheDataSource.FLAG_IGNORE_CACHE_ON_ERROR)
        }
        
        private fun getCacheSingleInstance(context: Context): Cache? {
            var cache: Cache? = null
            val cachePath = context.cacheDir.absolutePath + File.separator + PLAYER_CACHE_SUBDIRECTORY
            val cacheFile = File(cachePath)
            val isLocked = SimpleCache.isCacheFolderLocked(cacheFile)
            if (!isLocked) {
                cache =
                        SimpleCache(cacheFile, LeastRecentlyUsedCacheEvictor(DEFAULT_MAX_CACHE_SIZE), ExoDatabaseProvider(context))
            }
            return cache
        }
```

### [REQUIRED] Reproduction steps
This is an occasional crash. I haven't reproduced this crash yet, but from the crashlytics of the fabric, more than 600 users suffered it with more than 1800 times in the past 7 days.

### [REQUIRED] A full bug report captured from the device
Here below are the detailed crash message:
Crash 1, happened on multiple devices with system version 4, 5, and 6.
```
Fatal Exception: java.lang.StackOverflowError
       at java.util.WeakHashMap$Entry.<init> + 71(WeakHashMap.java:71)
```
